title: Senedj
summary: King listed in CFAH-7B Table 14 (Egypt Dynasty 2 (Thinis)).
description: Ruler of Egypt Dynasty 2 (Thinis). Person record added by the CFAH pass from the per-king rows of the OSF preprint CFAH-7B (Table 14, "Integrated Dates for Dynasty 2"); its dates are display only.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

standby.note: Standby placement only. Chronological Framework of Ancient History prints this BC/AD year on the reign entry (Start Sole-rex: 1822; End Sole-rex: 1806; Death or Deposition: 1781). It is not a sort year. No Anno Mundi, regnal length, or Julian Period figure was converted to obtain it.

reign.date: Start Sole-rex: 1822; End Sole-rex: 1806; Death or Deposition: 1781
reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-7B: Kings of Dynasties 1-13," OSF preprint v1.3 (10 Feb 2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/TUWNC, file CFAH 7-B Kings of Dynasties 1-13_v_1.3.pdf, Table 14 "Integrated Dates for Dynasty 2", p. 102
Cory, Ancient Fragments (London: Reeves & Turner, 1876, ed. E. Richmond Hodges), p. 113; Manetho, ap. Syncellus, Chronicon 54 to 59, and Eusebius, Chronicle 14 and 15
reign.note: Attached to the existing person senedj, whose alternate name is already Sethenes. Cory is not used to confirm that identification.
